findings.title: Food properly labeled; original container.
findings.comment: Various items that are packaged in house lacked specific label information. These items included packaged breads, veggies, seafood, etc. in many coolers, freezers, and shelves throughout the facility. Discussed with the PIC the required label information: common name of food, list of ingredients, name and place of business of manufacturer/distributor, and food source for each major food allergen. Ensure that the necessary information is included on packaged labels.
findings.citation_text: 3-602.11(A) Food Labels. (A) FOOD PACKAGED in a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, shall be labeled as specified in LAW, including 21 CFR 101 - Food labeling, and 9 CFR 317 Labeling, marking devices, and containers.
